title: Context concept
description: *.context.yaml — a context concept: a note selection. Static pins note body paths; dynamic retrieves by query. References notes by body path, never by opaque note UUID.

notes.description: static only — paths into this project's context vault (ADR 0006: project scope). Resolved to note ids at apply.

noteIds.description: static only — server note ids, an alternative to `notes` that skips path resolution (what `pull` emits, since ids have no reverse path mapping).

query.description: dynamic only — retrieval query over the project vault.

top_k.description: dynamic only — max notes retrieved per run.

kinds.description: dynamic only — restrict retrieval to these note kinds.
